description: The object-view - the ISO 8.4.3.1.2 Format 5 identifier, `identifier-1 AS { [FACTORY OF] object-class-name-1 [ONLY] | interface-name-1 | UNIVERSAL }` (8.4.3.5.2), which re-describes an object reference at compile time (8.4.3.5.4 GR1) with a run-time conformance check (GR2-GR6, EC-OO-CONFORMANCE). Reachable from every object-reference position (the INVOKE receiver, the inline invocation's receiver, SET Format 5's sender, RAISE), and parsed as a superset in the two object-reference RECEIVING positions so 8.4.3.5.3 SR2 names its own rule (kb/Work PB1425). Gated at 2002 with the rest of the OO CORE; THE EDGE IS DERIVED, NOT QUOTED (the VERSION_CHANGE_REFERENCE discipline - the repo holds no 2002 or 2014 text): (a) A.4.10 lists exactly three OPTIONAL object-orientation elements and the object-view is NOT among them, so it is mandatory OO surface, which this compiler gates at 2002 throughout, (b) Annex E itemizes the 2014->2023 delta and does not list it, so it predates 2023, (c) it re-describes a USAGE OBJECT REFERENCE item, itself a 2002 introduction. Below 2002 the VersionConformancePass parse arm names the edition on RECOGNITION (VisitObjectView -> 0900).
display: object-view identifier AS class / interface / UNIVERSAL
vcr: 2002 introduction (OO; derived - A.4.10 optional-list silence + Annex E silence + USAGE OBJECT REFERENCE 2002)
source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. OVW.
ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
CONFIGURATION SECTION.
REPOSITORY.
    CLASS OVWC.
DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 U USAGE OBJECT REFERENCE.
01 C USAGE OBJECT REFERENCE OVWC.
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    INVOKE OVWC "NEW" RETURNING U.
    SET C TO U AS OVWC.
    STOP RUN.
END PROGRAM OVW.

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
CLASS-ID. OVWC INHERITS FROM BASE.
ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
CONFIGURATION SECTION.
REPOSITORY.
    CLASS BASE.
END CLASS OVWC.
